svg.title: AI-Wrevolusi complete source schema
svg.desc: All 26 source model tables across current identity, learning, work, reference and separate legacy domains, with declared foreign keys distinguished from logical associations.

g.title: Identity and learning records
g.desc: Current ORM relationships at aa4f8fb • Repeated app_users boxes are the same table • No live database check

Workspace stores JSON strings by key. task_key identifies a browser task, not tasks.id.
PK = primary key FK = declared foreign key UQ = unique Solid = declared FK Dotted = logical association only
UQ learning_progress = user_id + skill_id + course_id + chapter_index. UQ daily_briefs = user_id + brief_date + variant.

g.title: Work and planning records
g.desc: Current ORM at aa4f8fb • Dashed table is modelled without an explicit current runtime write • No live database check
g.text: Current ORM at aa4f8fb • Dashed table is modelled without an explicit current runtime write • No live database check
The ORM occupations table and reference ref_occupations table are distinct. Their codes are not joined by a declared FK.
PK = primary key FK = declared foreign key UQ = unique Solid = declared FK Dotted = logical association only
All solid links are declared in ORM source. Optional occupation links use SET NULL. Other shown FK links use CASCADE.

g.title: Reference data and course catalogue

catalogue_chapters.parent_order is an optional within-course hierarchy value, not a declared self FK.

UQ catalogue_chapters = course_id + chapter_order. Reference table columns are declared in db/schema.sql.
